units.signed_well_depth_m: m; negative below surveyed ground elevation
units.hydraulic_head_m: m in surveyed well reference datum
units.elder_stage_above_reference_m: m above fixed 2.5 ft visualization reference

elder_stage.reference_basis: fixed visualization reference equal to the USGS operational minimum threshold; not a surveyed Rivendell datum
elder_stage.transfer_rule: max(0, daily_mean_stage_ft - reference_stage_ft) converted to metres and added to the mapped Rivendell stream-bed thalweg elevation

display_anchor.interpretation: visual proxy at the mapped Elder Creek thalweg beside Rivendell; the USGS gage is not physically co-located

vms_normalization.method: per-channel 5th and 95th percentiles of daily means within each water year
vms_normalization.partial_year_policy: reuse the most recent qualified water-year bounds; use fixed reference bounds only when no qualified prior water year is available
